ambiguities.fragment: allow System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow
ambiguities.explanation: The scope of 'allow' is syntactically ambiguous. It is unclear whether 'allow' applies only to 'System-C to subscribe' (System-A grants permission) or if it implies a broader capability where System-C is allowed to subscribe to any flow, or if the 'Reporting flow' itself has the capability to allow subscriptions.
possible_interpretations: System-A grants permission for System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow.
System-C is permitted to subscribe to the Reporting flow (implying the system architecture allows this action generally, not necessarily initiated by System-A).
textual_evidence: allow System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow
